en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural hilly landscape with cultivated fields divided into bands and patches. In the foreground stands a detached house with a tiled roof and several windows. A path or road winds up the hill in the background, with scattered trees and a small structure at the top. At the bottom of the image, there is Dutch text identifying the view as Vossenberg and Keteldal near the village Berg en Dal by Nijmegen.
